.. conf::
   :keys: commands_post
   :default: <empty list>

   Commands to run after running the :ref:`commands`. Execute regardless of the outcome of both :ref:`commands` and
   :ref:`commands_pre`. All evaluation and configuration logic applies from :ref:`commands`.
